description:
FILED s540 (the reviewing session, 2026-11-13) on the USER's word (paraphrased): a second task to review the rest of PCL, to see whether there are low-hanging fruits for making things faster.  Sibling of #4787 (which ranks by what the CPAN test suites spend); this one is a READING review backed by small measurements, for the parts a test-suite profile under-weights.

SCOPE (each part ends in a short ranked list: lever, measured or estimated gain in absolute time, size, risk)
1. THE EMITTED CODE: read the emission of the everyday corpus and of three or four real modules for shapes that cost at run time without need -- context binds (13.3 per 100 lines, codegen-review-s526 C4: the void-position bind as a Kind-A gate), boxes that never escape (90 % of lexicals stay boxed), p-setf's tail arms, generic calls where the compiler knows the type, repeated coercions of the same value, closures allocated per iteration.  PCL_OPT=none vs default per registry name gives the gain each existing transform holds; what is NOT yet a transform is the finding.
2. THE RUNTIME (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp): the hot helpers by call count over the bench + everyday corpus (unbox, box-set, to-number / to-string, p-method-call, hash and array access, p-list-=, string append, regex match entry) -- read for avoidable work: missing type declarations, generic arithmetic, consing in a fast path, weak / synchronized tables on a hot path (#4061), a lookup repeated per call that could be cached with a cheap validity test (the s534 pattern).  runtime-review-s525's three structural exceptions are inputs, not this task.
3. THE SHIMS (lib/): pure-Perl replacements of XS modules that programs lean on (List::Util, Scalar::Util, Data::Dumper, JSON::PP, Encode, Storable, Digest::*, POSIX) -- which are far slower than the XS they replace and have a cheap runtime primitive available.
4. THE COMPILE PIPELINE: transpile time per 1,000 lines by phase (PPI parse, the repair / rename passes, PExpr, emission, SBCL compile of the emitted Lisp); what is re-done per module that could be cached or skipped; the size of the emitted Lisp as a driver of SBCL compile time.  PPI::Node::find and the 18 re-parsing passes are known (#3694 owns them) -- list only what #3694 does not.
5. START-UP stays PARKED by the USER's ruling (#2422 / #1862 / #2421): re-measure the one number, do not design.

RULES: nothing is fixed in this task; every lever is FILED with its discriminating measurement (CLAUDE.md: a "suspect X" task carries the cheap measurement that would confirm or kill X).  Low-hanging = at most one session, no representation change, no ruling needed; the bigger ones are listed separately with what decision they wait for.  Deliverable: docs/speed-low-hanging-review-sNNN.md + the tasks.  Read first: docs/speed-review-s509.md, docs/method-lookup-eval-s534.md, docs/codegen-review-s526.md, docs/runtime-review-s525.md, docs/faster-codegen-suggestions.md, #4621.
=== DONE (s540b) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-13; code sha 05806e16, v2-13900; status left as it is)  The deliverable is docs/speed-low-hanging-review-s540.md: the method, five part tables (emitted code, runtime, shims, compile pipeline, start-up), THE LIST, the "not low-hanging" table, the older worklists item by item.  Measured through six heavy.sh legs (scratch/s540b/legs/leg1..6.log in the s540b worktree).
THE LIST (filed): #4981 tr/// re-expands per call (a Data::Dumper program 7.12 -> 0.59 s, Pod::Text -16 %); #4988 Digest::MD5 over sb-md5 (356 -> 6.65 us per KB); #4989 dclone by direct copy (3,000 copies 1.39 -> 0.084 s); #4982 fold a literal `use constant` (-70 % on a constant-check loop); #4983 `$|`'s weak probe on every print (+81 % on prints once set); #4990 base64 primitive (126 us per KB, perl 0.5); #4985 canonpath guard (-69 %); #4991 strftime (15.5 us, perl 1.9); #4984 p-hash presize (-15 % on a 10-key constructor).
REFUTED (measured): the void-position bind (C4: -2.2 % on 3 M calls), a plain-scalar arm in the string comparisons (json-rt -3.6 %, textproc +10.7 %), the #2610 detector table's bytes (1-4 % of a fasl build, nothing at run time).
NOT LOW-HANGING: local modules compiled from text every run (#4986, a ruling asked; 0.53 vs 0.055 s per run for a 2.4k-line module), a cheap compile policy (-53..-82 % compile-file; run-time price unmeasured), the vendored PPI rebuilding every run (#4987, cause narrowed to an ordering), the frame / `caller` (s539d), boxes for references and ref identity (representation), inherited method lookup (#4523-#4525), SHA (new code), string evals (parked), regex engine (parked), start-up (parked).
Also filed: #4992 (five registry names hold nothing measurable on the bench -- measure on real code before deleting).
subject: SPEED (USER s540): review the REST of PCL for low-hanging speed fruit -- everything the CPAN-suite comparison (#4787) does not point at: the emitted code's shapes, the runtime's hot helpers, the shims, the compile pipeline, start-up
